gap: Fresh code-contract review found disabled scanner reachability, cleanup trap/status bypasses, and startup failure outside the bounded fatal path.
hypothesis: The final3 runtime and release proofs were current, but structural mutation coverage still missed workflow conditional reachability, EXIT trap control flow, and startup rejection termination.
expected_value: Closing these gaps prevents false-green supply-chain gates and indefinitely hanging API startup failures.
estimated_cost: Two bounded implementation lanes, focused mutation tests, full local regression, exact OCI rebuild and another fresh-context review.
